This divides triangle ABC into two right triangles, ADC and BDC, which are congruent by the Side-Angle-Side (or Hypotenuse-Leg) rule: CD is common, angles at D are both 90 degrees, and AC = BC (since AB = AC and the triangle is isosceles, the sides AC and BC are equal, so the hypotenuses AC and BC are equal).
